architecture:
System: Operations-Console-127
Primary NIST family: Program Management (PM); evidence focus: PM-10.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: authorization roles and responsibilities are assigned and integrated into the organization-wide risk process. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
